messages:
maya: quick heads-up 1: nightly link-scan flagged two broken refs in runbooks/private-deploy.md (anchor + missing diagram). can someone triage?
tom: I can take a look now. which anchors/paths?
maya: scanner output:
```
404 /runbooks/private-deploy.md#secret-rotation
404 /static/diagrams/priv-topology-v2.png
```
rachel: that diagram was renamed during the docs reorg last week. i updated the TOC but missed the embed in the runbook.
tom: do we have the new filename? i can either re-point to the renamed file or rehost the archive copy into repo/static so previews work.
maya: new file lives at /static/diagrams/priv-topology-final.png in the archive. prefer re-point if that keeps canonical CDN usage. PRs are fine.
docs-bot: Suggestion: add CODEOWNERS entry for /runbooks/* to reduce ownership drift.
rachel: agreed on CODEOWNERS. also the anchor (#secret-rotation) looks like it was a heading rename. easiest fix: add a frontmatter alias for the old id so external links keep working.
tom: i'll open a tiny PR: update image path to the archive canonical, add frontmatter aliases for the two old anchors, include a short changelog note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7120
maya: pinging @rachel for review. can you confirm the archive image is ok to reference?
rachel: confirmed. LGTM for pointing at the canonical archive path. one ask: add an HTML comment in the markdown mentioning that infra will reconcile CDN mapping (ticket INF-2468).
tom: added the comment and ticket link in the PR. CI preview passed locally but netlify preview failed earlier due to an unrelated build timing issue 1: will re-run CI after merge.
maya: thanks. after merge, can we add a quick blurb to the runbook changelog so oncall knows about the alias?
rachel: yep i'll add changelog line in a follow-up commit.
docs-bot: INF ticket INF-2468 created for infra to reclaim canonical CDN path. Assigned eng-infra.
tom: PR merged by rachel. closing loop.
maya: great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
